summary: Submitted the closing handoff product for this run, updated with the two witnesses accepted since the earlier summary; preflight returns valid:true. The accepted outcome just before it: the review of artifact 957c9f5eeb714c6cb5ed66785d90e8c2 (the truncated-log variant of the commit-context finding) was accepted, so that second witness is confirmed as well. The handoff lists eleven confirmed obligations with an executed, reviewed check for each: election-term context published below an adopted term, reproduced both with a substitute stream layer and over the production TCP transport; client requests left unresolved on an inactive raft and one accepted while leading left unresolved after shutdown; a second, different vote persisted for the same term; two leaders of one term, with the overlap-window variant as a bounded negative that holds; GetConfiguration reporting index zero for a configuration established at index one; a reported commit index naming an entry the voting quorum does not store; a leader with a reachable quorum stepping down under the lease check; the commit context below applied state on the runtime install path with the log left intact, again with the receiver configured to truncate at the snapshot index, and again after a restart restoring the node's own snapshot; and VerifyLeader confirming leadership on non-voter acknowledgements with one non-voter against two voters and with two non-voters against three voters. Remaining items are stated concretely: the repair locations for the whole set are open with no source naming the intended layer; no external consumer was exercised for the client-contract findings; the campaign path of a server without a vote is not fully read though the voter-side refusal guard is located; the transfer path accepts a non-voter target and reported success with no leader established, uncovered by any obligation; the deferred or unread surfaces remain third-party SetHeartbeatHandler transports, the MonotonicLogStore and snapshot-compaction interplay, the nested fuzzy and raft-compat modules, and mixed reachable-voter/non-voter layouts; and the commit-context witnesses do not include the post-install log range, so the truncation itself is not directly witnessed in the second scenario while the judged value does not depend on it. The product claims no map change and offers no exploration or construction run as evidence. Run state: audit spec v13, all units checked, 2 audit units, 19 experiments, 9 semantic reviews and roughly a minute remaining.
